findings.finding: AC-H1 Pinned versions do not install: openapi-typescript 7.13.0 needs TypeScript 5 but 6.0.3 is pinned; eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y 6.10.2 supports ESLint up to 9 but 10.11.0 is pinned; with engine-strict, eslint-plugin-astro, astro-eslint-parser need Node 22.22.3 or later and license-checker-rseidelsohn needs Node 24. npm ci fails at step one.
AC-H2 swup swaps only main so header, language switcher, aria-current, footer newsletter form and concept sentence go stale after a transition (FR-24, FR-10, FR-17, NFR-3).

SEC-H1 Start guard checks only the listen address; PUBLIC_ORIGIN https plus TRUSTED_PROXIES with a local reverse proxy or tunnel passes it, leaving the admin portal exposed without a second factor (TM-21, G-22). Require loopback PUBLIC_ORIGIN, empty TRUSTED_PROXIES, loopback peers, 421 on forwarding headers.
AC-M1 / SEC-M1 Contract: admin GETs omit 403 (setup_required, password_change_required); no 500; 429 missing on several writes; guard order undefined.
AC-M2 Licences not on allow-list in the shipped tree and undocumented: BlueOak-1.0.0 (lru-cache, sax, common-ancestor-path) and Python-2.0 (argparse); npm run licences will fail; ADD to T2 approvals.
AC-M3 Data model stores the newest consent wording label rather than the label in the signed token (defeats D-2).
AC-M4 Restore steps omit the retention purge so restore can resurrect expired personal data.
AC-M5 No way to read the security event record although ACs require it; add a read only command.
AC-M6 Release install path equals developer setup (dev dependencies, browser download, rebuild); give the release its own production install.
AC-M7 Wording archive D-2 pending T2 yet built into first migration with foreign keys and no fallback.
SEC-M2 Image worker is not a real sandbox (same user, full file and network access); use unshare or bubblewrap on Linux and pass input as an open descriptor.
SEC-M3 Sensitive admin actions (create, reset, update, delete account, export subscribers) do not re-ask for the password (ASVS 3.7.1); admin can reset own password without current password.
findings.where: contract createAccount 720, resetAccountPassword 817, updateAccount 757, deleteAccount 791, exportSubscribers 1610

findings.finding: SEC-M4 Personal data in URL query strings (search by email, upload name) will reach access logs; use POST body or strip query strings in logs.

Architecture and security lows: 127.0.0.1 gets 421 (L1); Astro checkOrigin overrides the contract 403 page (L2); ETag vs per response token (L3); backup VACUUM and gzip block the event loop (L4); hand made backup encryption format and scrypt maxmem default fails on Node 22 (L5); swup forms plugin may lose typed values (L6); stale text across documents (L7); Drizzle unproven for this schema (L8); 9 contract lint warnings (L9); verify builds twice (L10); rich text link attributes, Cf character rule, password hash queue cap, lockout on wrong current password, healthz writes, restore trusts archive schema, IPv6 /64 rate key, localhost cookie sharing, shared origin residual risk, contract path patterns, dev server guards, background GET refreshes idle timeout.

actions: Fix AC-H1, AC-H2 and SEC-H1 (high) and the medium findings in the architecture, ADRs, contract, repo plan and data model.
Add BlueOak-1.0.0 and Python-2.0 to the T2 licence approvals alongside SQLite and libvips.
Re-run the consultant and security review on the fixes, then re-record the gate.
